snippet.title: MiniMonos Flight for iDevice!
snippet.description: Become a flying monkey and soar through the sky catching clouds in this totally addictive iDevice game!  Have a blast banking your winning banana chips on MiniMonos Island but watch out for nasty thunder clouds!
